title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向
authors: Zorzi, Nathan, Beraja, Martin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。

title: An Experimental Implementation of the Core
title_zh: 核心的实验实现
authors: Leng, Ailin
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Microeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This study experimentally examines a non-cooperative implementation of the core. The protocol adopts a continuous-time frame, which allows a flexible coalition formation process. In the experiment, the core can be a singleton, a set of points that excludes the equal split, or an expanded set of points that includes the equal split. Meanwhile, predictions of the nucleolus and the Shapley value are also discussed for comparison. Results show that although the grand coalition is not always agreed on, the payoffs averaged across all formed coalitions are consistent with the core’s prediction in each scenario.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过实验考察了核心的非合作实现方式。实验协议采用连续时间框架，允许灵活的联盟形成过程。在实验中，核心可以是单点集、排除均分结果的点集，或包含均分结果的扩展点集。同时，为便于比较，还讨论了核仁解和沙普利值的预测结果。结果表明，尽管大联盟并非总能达成一致，但在每种情境下，所有已形成联盟的平均收益均与核心的预测结果一致。

title: How large current account imbalances unwind: Evidence from historical adjustment episodes
title_zh: 经常账户失衡如何消退：来自历史调整时期的证据
authors: Erik Frohm, John Hooley, Fatih Ozturk, Lukasz Rawdanowicz, Nivetha Sivakumar
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Global imbalances are back in the policy debate. This column examines 70 current account adjustment episodes across 51 economies from 1980 to 2024 to discover how large imbalances have unwound in the past. Three lessons stand out: adjustments are fairly common but slow; deficit and surplus narrowing work through different channels; and larger imbalances – especially deficits – are significantly more likely to correct.
abstract_zh: 全球失衡问题重新成为政策辩论的焦点。本文考察了1980年至2024年间51个经济体的70次经常账户调整事件，以探究过去大规模失衡是如何化解的。三个关键启示值得关注：调整虽较为常见但进程缓慢；赤字与盈余的收窄通过不同渠道实现；规模较大的失衡——尤其是赤字——更有可能得到纠正。

title: A new approach to the analysis of cooperation under the shadow of the future: Theory and experimental evidence
title_zh: 未来阴影下合作分析的新方法：理论与实验证据
authors: Melis Kartal, Wieland Müller
abstract: The theory of infinitely repeated games may lack predictive power due to its insensitivity to, for example, changes in some game parameters, the timing of players' moves, and communication possibilities. We propose a new approach by studying an infinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma game and its variants where preferences for cooperation are heterogeneous, and strategic risk arises from incomplete information about opponents' preferences. Our model generates a rich set of comparative static predictions in a variety of settings. We show that, unlike standard theory and other existing models, our approach organizes the findings of a host of experiments including our novel experiments.
abstract_zh: 无限重复博弈理论可能因对某些博弈参数变化、玩家行动时机及沟通可能性等因素不敏感而缺乏预测力。我们提出一种新方法，通过研究无限重复囚徒困境博弈及其变体，其中合作偏好具有异质性，且战略风险源于对对手偏好的不完全信息。我们的模型在多种情境下生成丰富的比较静态预测。研究表明，与标准理论及其他现有模型不同，我们的方法能够系统性地解释包括我们新实验在内的一系列实验结果。

title: Large structural VARs with multiple sign and ranking restrictions
title_zh: 具有多重符号与排序约束的大型结构向量自回归模型
authors: Joshua C. C. Chan, Christian Matthes, Xuewen Yu
abstract: Large VARs are increasingly used in structural analysis as a unified framework to study the impacts of multiple structural shocks simultaneously. However, the concurrent identification of multiple shocks using sign and ranking restrictions poses significant practical challenges to the point where existing algorithms cannot be used with such large VARs. To address this, we introduce a new numerically efficient algorithm that facilitates the estimation of impulse responses and related measures in large structural VARs identified with a large number of structural restrictions on impulse responses. The methodology is illustrated using a 35‐variable VAR with over 100 sign and ranking restrictions to identify 8 structural shocks.
abstract_zh: 大型VAR模型在结构分析中日益被用作统一框架，以同时研究多种结构性冲击的影响。然而，利用符号约束和排序约束同时识别多种冲击在实际操作中面临重大挑战，以至于现有算法无法应用于此类大型VAR模型。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新的数值高效算法，该算法有助于在大型结构VAR模型中估计脉冲响应及相关指标，这些模型通过大量脉冲响应结构约束进行识别。该方法通过一个包含35个变量、超过100个符号和排序约束的VAR模型来识别8种结构性冲击，并以此为例进行说明。

title: Market Power Is Power
title_zh: 市场力量即权力
authors: Gabriele Gratton, Barton Lee, Gabriele Gratton; Barton Lee
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We argue that in market democracies firms can wield political power through a mechanism that does not rely on lobbying, campaign contributions, or persuasion. When voters cannot commit to future regulation, firms can use irreversible technological investments to reshape ex-post political incentives. We call this mechanism the political hold-up problem. We show that, in equilibrium, a firm's de facto power to avoid regulation coincides with standard measures of market power. This form of power is robust to a wide range of regulatory instruments, including bans, taxes, self-regulation, and delegation to technocrats, and limits the effectiveness of reforms targeting political influence. The political hold-up problem distorts the direction of technological progress and may increase political demand for populism and nationalization. Institutional remedies instead require commitment: supermajoritarian institutions and independent oversight of industry standards.
abstract_zh: 本文论证，在市场民主国家中，企业可通过一种不依赖游说、政治献金或说服的机制行使政治权力。当选民无法对未来监管做出承诺时，企业能够利用不可逆的技术投资重塑事后政治激励。我们将此机制称为"政治套牢问题"。研究表明，在均衡状态下，企业规避监管的事实权力与市场势力的标准度量指标相吻合。这种权力形式对包括禁令、税收、自我监管及技术官僚授权在内的广泛监管工具具有稳健性，并会限制针对政治影响力的改革效力。政治套牢问题会扭曲技术进步方向，并可能加剧对民粹主义与国有化的政治需求。制度性补救措施则需要承诺机制：超级多数制度与行业标准的独立监督。

title: Double Inertia, Taylor Rules, and Monetary Policy Gradualism
title_zh: 联邦储备系统理事会
authors: Edmund Crawley, William Goodwin, Margaret M. Jacobson, Fabian Winkler
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: In recent decades, an empirically estimated double-inertial rule fits the path of changes in the federal funds rate better than a standard inertial Taylor rule. Inertial Taylor rules aim to capture monetary policy gradualism via slow adjustments in the level of the policy rate. Double-inertial rules build on this specification by also gradually adjusting the pace of change in the policy rate. Because a double-inertial rule explains more than twice the variation of changes in the policy rate than its standard inertial counterpart, we argue that practitioners should consider a double-inertial rule when characterizing U.S. monetary policy.

title: Outsourcing Agricultural Services and Risk Reduction in Smallholder Rice Farming: Evidence From China and Global Implications
title_zh: 农业服务外包与小农户水稻种植中的风险降低：来自中国的证据及全球启示
authors: Jian Zhang, Ashok K. Mishra, Gaoli Zhu, Awais Jabbar
abstract: ABSTRACT Smallholder farmers in developing countries face the twin challenges of improving productivity and managing agricultural risks. One emerging response is outsourcing production tasks to specialized service providers. Using plot‐level data from rice farms in Jiangsu Province, China, and an endogenous treatment‐regression model, this study examines the effects of outsourcing on yields and production risks. Results show that outsourcing increases rice yields by nearly 3%, reduces yield volatility, and lowers the probability of crop failure. These benefits arise from greater access to mechanized services, the substitution of machinery for labor, and more efficient use of inputs. However, outcomes vary by type: machinery‐intensive outsourcing reduces risk, whereas labor‐intensive outsourcing can exacerbate it in weak service markets. Gains are greatest on larger and more fertile plots, underscoring the importance of policies that support mechanization and competitive service markets.

title: Land Consolidation, Tenure Documentation, and Land Rental Markets: Evidence from rural Vietnam
title_zh: 土地整合、产权登记与土地租赁市场：来自越南农村的证据
authors: Kim Lan Nguyen
abstract: ABSTRACT Land fragmentation is widely recognized as a constraint on smallholder agriculture, raising production costs, limiting mechanization, and reducing efficiency. Land consolidation programs have been introduced in many countries to address this problem, yet their economic effects depend not only on plot reconfiguration but also on institutional implementation and land market functioning. This paper examines the impacts of Vietnam's state‐led land consolidation program using six waves of household panel data (2008–2018) from two provinces where consolidation was implemented. Impacts are estimated with two‐way fixed effects and a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach that accounts for heterogeneous adoption timing. The results show that the consolidation program substantially reduced land fragmentation: the number of plots per household fell by roughly three plots, average plot size increased by about 66 percent, and the distance between plots and homesteads declined by approximately 23 percent. At the same time, administrative delays in reissuing land‐use‐right certificates temporarily reduced the share of titled and collateral‐eligible land. While households’ overall access to credit is not adversely affected, land rental markets are significantly disrupted, with both rent‐in and rent‐out declining. Such reductions in land transactions may impede efficient land reallocation and operational scale adjustment, thereby delaying investment and productivity gains from improved land structure. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of institutional implementation and complementary market functioning for realizing the benefits of land consolidation in Vietnam and other smallholder economies.
